contentBlocks.body: A left join keeps every customer even when no order matches. The missing order side contains NULL, so checking the non-nullable order primary key for NULL identifies unmatched customers. This is an anti-join pattern. An inner join could never find these customers because it removes them before the WHERE clause runs.
